evidence: Carries the Validation label and modifies block index candidate tracking, unlinked block management, and pruning in src/validation.cpp and src/node/blockstorage.cpp.
rationale: Fixes inconsistent block index state, crash assertions under CheckBlockIndex (#31512, #36021), and undefined behavior from mutating candidate keys in setBlockIndexCandidates.
